en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah informed us, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, who said: I heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ask his companions: What have you heard about staying in Makkah? Al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid said: I heard al-Ala, or al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami, say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The Muhajir may remain in Makkah for three days after completing his rites.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah berichtete uns, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, who said: I heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ask his companions: What have you heard about staying in Makka? Al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid said: I heard al-Ala, or al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami, say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The Muhajir may remain in Makka for three Tage after completing his rites. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Hasan al-Hulwani and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, both from Yaqub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd. He said: My father narrated to us, from Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, that he heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ask al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid. Al-Sa'ib said: I heard al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: The Muhajir remains in Makkah for three nights after departure.
de: Hasan al-Hulwani and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns, both from Yaqub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd. Er sagte: My father überlieferte uns, from Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, that he heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ask al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid. Al-Sa'ib said: I heard al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami say: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: The Muhajir remains in Makka for three nights after departure. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us and dictated it to us. Ismail ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'd informed me that Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf informed him that al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid informed him that al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami informed him from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), who said: The stay of the Muhajir in Makkah after completing his rites is three days.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns and dictated it to us. Ismail ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'd berichtete mir that Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf informed him that al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid informed him that al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami informed him from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: The stay of the Muhajir in Makka after completing his rites is three Tage. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated to me. al-Dahhak ibn Makhlad narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us, with this chain and the same meaning.
de: Hadschaj ibn al-Sha'ir überlieferte mir. al-Dahhak ibn Makhlad überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns, with this chain and the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas. He said: On the day of the conquest, the conquest of Makkah, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: There is no emigration after the conquest, but there is jihad and intention, and when you are called to go forth, then go forth. On the day of the conquest he also said: Allah made this city sacred on the day He created the heavens and the earth. It is sacred by Allah's sanctity until the Day of Resurrection. Fighting in it was not lawful for anyone before me, and it was not lawful for me except for an hour of the day. It is sacred by Allah's sanctity until the Day of Resurrection. Its thorny plants must not be cut, its game must not be frightened, its lost property may be picked up only by one who announces it, and its fresh grass must not be cut. Al-Abbas said: Except for idhkhir, Messenger of Allah, for it is used by their metalworkers and in their houses. He said: Except for idhkhir.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali überlieferte uns. Jarir überlieferte uns, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: On the day of the conquest, the conquest of Makka, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: There is no emigration after the conquest, but there is jihad and intention, and when you are called to go forth, then go forth. On the day of the conquest he also said: Allah made this city heilig on the day He created the heavens and the earth. It is heilig by Allah's Heiligkeit until the Day of Resurrection. Fighting in it was not erlaubt for anyone before me, and it was not erlaubt for me except for an hour of the day. It is heilig by Allah's Heiligkeit until the Day of Resurrection. Its thorny plants must not be cut, its game must not be frightened, its lost property may be picked up only by one who announces it, and its fresh grass must not be cut. Al-Abbas said: Except for idhkhir, Messenger of Allah, for it is used by their metalworkers and in their Hauss. Er sagte: Except for idhkhir. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Yahya ibn Adam narrated to us. Mufaddal narrated to us, from Mansur, with this chain and the same meaning. He did not mention: on the day He created the heavens and the earth. He used 'killing' instead of 'fighting', and said: No one may pick up its lost property except one who announces it.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Adam überlieferte uns. Mufaddal überlieferte uns, from Mansur, with this chain and the same meaning. He did not mention: on the day He created the heavens and the earth. He used 'killing' instead of 'fighting', and said: No one may pick up its lost property except one who announces it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. They said: Jarir informed us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas. He said: On the day of the conquest, the conquest of Makkah, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: There is no emigration after the conquest, but there is jihad and intention, and when you are called to go forth, then go forth.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. They said: Jarir berichtete uns, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: On the day of the conquest, the conquest of Makka, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: There is no emigration after the conquest, but there is jihad and intention, and when you are called to go forth, then go forth. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. They said: Waki narrated to us, from Sufyan. H; Ishaq ibn Mansur and Ibn Rafi narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Adam. Mufaddal, meaning Ibn Muhalhil, narrated to us. H; Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa informed us, from Israil. All of them narrated from Mansur, with this chain and the same meaning.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. They said: Waki überlieferte uns, from Sufyan. H; Ishaq ibn Mansur and Ibn Rafi überlieferte uns, from Yahya ibn Adam. Mufaddal, meaning Ibn Muhalhil, überlieferte uns. H; Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa berichtete uns, from Israil. All of them narrated from Mansur, with this chain and the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Abu Shurayh al-Adawi. He said to Amr ibn Sa'id, while he was sending troops to Makkah: Permit me, governor, to tell you a statement with which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) stood on the day after the conquest. My ears heard it, my heart understood it, and my eyes saw him when he spoke it. He praised Allah, then said: Allah made Makkah sacred; people did not make it sacred. It is not lawful for anyone who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood there or cut a tree there. If anyone invokes the permission of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) to fight there, tell him: Allah permitted His Messenger, but did not permit you. He permitted me there for an hour of the day, and its sanctity has returned today as it was yesterday. Let those present convey this to those absent. Abu Shurayh was asked what Amr said to him. He said: I know this better than you, Abu Shurayh. The sanctuary does not protect a disobedient person, one fleeing after shedding blood, or one fleeing after theft.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Abu Shurayh al-Adawi. He said to Amr ibn Sa'id, while he was sending troops to Makka: Permit me, governor, to tell you a statement with which der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) stood on the day after the conquest. My ears heard it, my heart understood it, and my eyes saw him when he spoke it. He praised Allah, then said: Allah made Makka heilig; people did not make it heilig. It is not erlaubt for anyone who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood there or cut a tree there. If anyone invokes the permission of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) to fight there, tell him: Allah permitted His Messenger, but did not permit you. He permitted me there for an hour of the day, and its Heiligkeit has returned today as it was yesterday. Let those present convey this to those absent. Abu Shurayh was asked what Amr said to him. Er sagte: I know this better than you, Abu Shurayh. The sanctuary does not protect a disobedient person, one fleeing after shedding blood, or one fleeing after theft. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, both from al-Walid. Zuhayr said: al-Walid ibn Muslim narrated to us. Al-Awzai narrated to us. Yahya ibn Abi Kathir narrated to me. Abu Salamah, the son of Abd al-Rahman, narrated to me. Abu Hurayra narrated to me. He said: When Allah granted His Messenger (peace be upon him) victory over Makkah, he stood among the people, praised Allah, and said: Allah held back the elephant from Makkah and gave His Messenger and the believers authority over it. It was not lawful for anyone before me, it was made lawful for me for an hour of the day, and it will not be lawful for anyone after me. Its game must not be frightened, its thorny plants must not be cut, and its fallen property is not lawful except for one who announces it. Whoever has a slain relative has the better of two choices: compensation or retaliation. Al-Abbas said: Except for idhkhir, Messenger of Allah, for we use it in our graves and houses. He said: Except for idhkhir. Abu Shah, a man from Yemen, stood and said: Write it for me, Messenger of Allah. He said: Write it for Abu Shah. Al-Walid said: I asked al-Awzai what he meant by 'Write it for me'. He said: This sermon that he heard from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, both from al-Walid. Zuhayr said: al-Walid ibn Muslim überlieferte uns. Al-Awzai überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Abi Kathir überlieferte mir. Abu Salamah, the son of Abd al-Rahman, überlieferte mir. Abu Hurayra überlieferte mir. Er sagte: When Allah granted His Messenger (peace be upon him) victory over Makka, he stood among the people, praised Allah, and said: Allah held back the elephant from Makka and gave His Messenger and the believers authority over it. It was not erlaubt for anyone before me, it was made erlaubt for me for an hour of the day, and it will not be erlaubt for anyone after me. Its game must not be frightened, its thorny plants must not be cut, and its fallen property is not erlaubt except for one who announces it. Whoever has a slain relative has the better of two choices: compensation or retaliation. Al-Abbas said: Except for idhkhir, Messenger of Allah, for we use it in our graves and Hauss. Er sagte: Except for idhkhir. Abu Shah, a man from Yemen, stood and said: Write it for me, Messenger of Allah. Er sagte: Write it for Abu Shah. Al-Walid said: I asked al-Awzai what he meant by 'Write it for me'. Er sagte: This sermon that he heard from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa informed us, from Shayban, from Yahya. Abu Salamah informed me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: Khuzah killed a man from Banu Layth in the year of the conquest of Makkah, in retaliation for a man they had killed. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was told, so he mounted his riding animal and delivered a sermon: Allah held back the elephant from Makkah and gave His Messenger and the believers authority over it. It was not lawful for anyone before me and will not be lawful for anyone after me. It was made lawful for me for an hour of the day, and this hour is now sacred. Its thorny plants must not be struck, its trees must not be cut, and its fallen property may be picked up only by one who announces it. Whoever has a slain relative has the better of two choices: compensation, meaning blood money, or that the killer's family be handed over. A man from Yemen named Abu Shah came and said: Write it for me, Messenger of Allah. He said: Write it for Abu Shah. A Qurashi man said: Except for idhkhir, for we use it in our houses and graves. He said: Except for idhkhir.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa berichtete uns, from Shayban, from Yahya. Abu Salamah berichtete mir that he heard Abu Hurayra say: Khuzah killed a man from Banu Layth in the year of the conquest of Makka, in retaliation for a man they had killed. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was told, so he mounted his riding animal and delivered a sermon: Allah held back the elephant from Makka and gave His Messenger and the believers authority over it. It was not erlaubt for anyone before me and will not be erlaubt for anyone after me. It was made erlaubt for me for an hour of the day, and this hour is now heilig. Its thorny plants must not be struck, its trees must not be cut, and its fallen property may be picked up only by one who announces it. Whoever has a slain relative has the better of two choices: compensation, meaning blood money, or that the killer's family be handed over. A man from Yemen named Abu Shah came and said: Write it for me, Messenger of Allah. Er sagte: Write it for Abu Shah. A Qurashi man said: Except for idhkhir, for we use it in our Hauss and graves. Er sagte: Except for idhkhir. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. Ibn Ayun narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. He said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) say: It is not lawful for any of you to carry weapons in Makkah.
de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. Ibn Ayun überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. Er sagte: I heard der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) say: It is not erlaubt for any of you to carry weapons in Makka. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi, Yahya ibn Yahya, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Al-Qanabi said: I read to Malik ibn Anas. Qutaybah said: Malik narrated to us. Yahya, and this is his wording, said: I asked Malik: Did Ibn Shihab narrate to you from Anas ibn Malik that the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered Makkah in the year of the conquest wearing a helmet? When he removed it, a man came and said: Ibn Khatal is clinging to the curtains of the Ka'bah. He said: Kill him. Malik said: Yes.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi, Yahya ibn Yahya, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Al-Qanabi said: I read to Malik ibn Anas. Qutaybah said: Malik überlieferte uns. Yahya, and this is his wording, said: I asked Malik: Did Ibn Shihab narrate to you from Anas ibn Malik that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered Makka in the year of the conquest wearing a helmet? When he removed it, a man came and said: Ibn Khatal is clinging to the curtains of the Ka'bah. Er sagte: Kill him. Malik said: Yes. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id al-Thaqafi narrated to us. Yahya said: He informed us, and Qutaybah said: Muawiyah ibn Ammar al-Duhni narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered Makkah, and Qutaybah said: on the day of the conquest of Makkah, wearing a black turban and not in ihram. Qutaybah's narration says: Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jabir.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id al-Thaqafi überlieferte uns. Yahya said: He berichtete uns, and Qutaybah said: Muawiyah ibn Ammar al-Duhni überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) entered Makka, and Qutaybah said: on the day of the conquest of Makka, wearing a schwarzen Turban and not in ihram. Qutaybah's narration says: Abu al-Zubayr überlieferte uns, from Jabir. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ali ibn Hakim al-Awdi narrated to us. Sharik informed us, from Ammar al-Duhni, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered Makkah on the day of the conquest wearing a black turban.
de: Ali ibn Hakim al-Awdi überlieferte uns. Sharik berichtete uns, from Ammar al-Duhni, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered Makka on the day of the conquest wearing a schwarzen Turban. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. They said: Waki informed us, from Musawir al-Warraq, from Ja'far ibn Amr ibn Hurayth, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) addressed the people while wearing a black turban.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. They said: Waki berichtete uns, from Musawir al-Warraq, from Ja'far ibn Amr ibn Hurayth, from his father, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) addressed the people while wearing a schwarzen Turban. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Hasan al-Hulwani narrated to us. They said: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Musawir al-Warraq. He said: Ja'far ibn Amr ibn Hurayth narrated to me, from his father. He said: It is as though I can see the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the pulpit wearing a black turban whose two ends hung between his shoulders. Abu Bakr did not say: on the pulpit.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Hasan al-Hulwani überlieferte uns. They said: Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Musawir al-Warraq. Er sagte: Ja'far ibn Amr ibn Hurayth überlieferte mir, from his father. Er sagte: It is as though I can see der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the pulpit wearing a schwarzen Turban whose two ends hung between his shoulders. Abu Bakr did not say: on the pulpit. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz, meaning Ibn Muhammad al-Darawardi, narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya al-Mazini, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle Abd Allah ibn Zayd ibn Asim, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Ibrahim made Makkah sacred and prayed for its people, and I have made Madinah sacred as Ibrahim made Makkah sacred. I have prayed for blessing in its measure and its sa, with twice what Ibrahim prayed for the people of Makkah.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz, meaning Ibn Muhammad al-Darawardi, überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya al-Mazini, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle Abd Allah ibn Zayd ibn Asim, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Ibrahim made Makka heilig and prayed for its people, and I have made Medina heilig as Ibrahim made Makka heilig. I have prayed for blessing in its measure and its sa, with twice what Ibrahim prayed for the people of Makka. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated it to me. Abd al-Aziz, meaning Ibn al-Mukhtar, narrated to us. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Khalid ibn Makhlad narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to me. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Al-Makhzumi informed us. Wuhaib narrated to us. All of them narrated from Amr ibn Yahya al-Mazini, with this chain. Wuhaib's narration says: with twice what Ibrahim prayed for. Sulayman ibn Bilal and Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar's narrations say: with the like of what Ibrahim prayed for.
de: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated it to me. Abd al-Aziz, meaning Ibn al-Mukhtar, überlieferte uns. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Khalid ibn Makhlad überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte mir. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Al-Makhzumi berichtete uns. Wuhaib überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Amr ibn Yahya al-Mazini, with this chain. Wuhaib's narration says: with twice what Ibrahim prayed for. Sulayman ibn Bilal and Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar's narrations say: with the like of what Ibrahim prayed for. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Bakr, meaning Ibn Mudar, narrated to us, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abd Allah ibn Amr ibn Uthman, from Rafi ibn Khadij. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Ibrahim made Makkah sacred, and I make sacred what lies between the two lava fields of Madinah.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Bakr, meaning Ibn Mudar, überlieferte uns, from Ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abd Allah ibn Amr ibn Uthman, from Rafi ibn Khadij. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Ibrahim made Makka heilig, and I make heilig what lies between the two lava fields of Medina. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Utbah ibn Muslim, from Nafi ibn Jubayr. Marwan ibn al-Hakam addressed the people, mentioning Makkah, its people, and its sanctity, but he did not mention Madinah, its people, and its sanctity. Rafi ibn Khadij called to him: Why do I hear you mention Makkah, its people, and its sanctity, but not Madinah, its people, and its sanctity, when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) made sacred what lies between its two lava fields? We have that recorded on Khawlani leather; if you wish, I can read it to you. Marwan was silent, then said: I have heard some of that.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte uns, from Utbah ibn Muslim, from Nafi ibn Jubayr. Marwan ibn al-Hakam addressed the people, mentioning Makka, its people, and its Heiligkeit, but he did not mention Medina, its people, and its Heiligkeit. Rafi ibn Khadij called to him: Why do I hear you mention Makka, its people, and its Heiligkeit, but not Medina, its people, and its Heiligkeit, when der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) made heilig what lies between its two lava fields? We have that recorded on Khawlani leather; if you wish, I can read it to you. Marwan was silent, then said: I have heard some of that. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, both from Abu Ahmad. Abu Bakr said: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah al-Asadi narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Ibrahim made Makkah sacred, and I have made Madinah sacred, between its two lava fields. Its thorny trees must not be cut and its game must not be hunted.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Amr al-Naqid überlieferte uns, both from Abu Ahmad. Abu Bakr said: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah al-Asadi überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. Er sagte: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Ibrahim made Makka heilig, and I have made Medina heilig, between its two lava fields. Its thorny trees must not be cut and its game must not be hunted. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Uthman ibn Hakim narrated to us. Amir ibn Sa'd narrated to me, from his father. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I make sacred what lies between the two lava fields of Madinah: its thorny trees must not be cut and its game must not be killed. He said: Madinah is better for them, if they knew. No one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with one better than him. No one remains patient through its hardship and difficulty except that I will be an intercessor or witness for him on the Day of Resurrection.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Uthman ibn Hakim überlieferte uns. Amir ibn Sa'd überlieferte mir, from his father. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I make heilig what lies between the two lava fields of Medina: its thorny trees must not be cut and its game must not be killed. Er sagte: Medina is better for them, if they knew. No one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with one better than him. No one remains patient through its hardship and difficulty except that I will be an intercessor or witness for him on the Day of Resurrection. en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Marwan ibn Muawiyah narrated to us. Uthman ibn Hakim al-Ansari narrated to us. Amir ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas informed me, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, then he mentioned the same as Ibn Numayr's hadith and added: Whoever intends evil for the people of Madinah, Allah will melt him in the Fire as lead is melted, or as salt is melted in water.
de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Marwan ibn Muawiyah überlieferte uns. Uthman ibn Hakim al-Ansari überlieferte uns. Amir ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas berichtete mir, from his father, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said, then he mentioned the same as Ibn Numayr's hadith and added: Whoever intends evil for the people of Medina, Allah will melt him in the Feuer as lead is melted, or as salt is melted in water. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, both from al-Aqadi. Abd said: Abd al-Malik ibn Amr informed us. Abd Allah ibn Ja'far narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Muhammad, from Amir ibn Sa'd. Sa'd rode to his palace at al-Aqiq and found a slave cutting trees or striking them. He took away what the slave had taken. When Sa'd returned, the slave's family came and asked him to return to their servant, or to them, what he had taken from their servant. He said: Allah forbid that I return anything that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) gave me as a privilege. He refused to return it to them.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns, both from al-Aqadi. Abd said: Abd al-Malik ibn Amr berichtete uns. Abd Allah ibn Ja'far überlieferte uns, from Ismail ibn Muhammad, from Amir ibn Sa'd. Sa'd rode to his palace at al-Aqiq and found a slave cutting trees or striking them. He took away what the slave had taken. When Sa'd returned, the slave's family came and asked him to return to their servant, or to them, what he had taken from their servant. en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail ibn Ja'far narrated to us. Amr ibn Abi Amr, the freedman of al-Muttalib ibn Abd Allah ibn Hantab, informed me that he heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to Abu Talhah: Find me a young servant from your servants to serve me. Abu Talhah took me behind him, and I served the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) whenever he stopped. In the hadith he said: When Uhud came into view, he said: This is a mountain that loves us and we love it. When he looked over Madinah, he said: O Allah, I make sacred what lies between its two mountains, as Ibrahim made Makkah sacred. O Allah, bless their mudd and sa.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail ibn Ja'far überlieferte uns. en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They said: Yaqub, Ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qari, narrated to us, from Amr ibn Abi Amr, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning, except that he said: I make sacred what lies between its two lava fields.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns.
